description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' that provides a method for generating URL-friendly slugs from input phrases. It includes regex-based transformations to clean up and format strings for URLs.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing URL slug generation functions.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Extends the string class to generate URL-friendly slugs by sanitizing and truncating input phrases.

methods.name: InvalidCharsRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches invalid characters in URLs.

methods.name: MultipleSpacesRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches multiple whitespace characters.

methods.name: TrimRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches whitespace for hyphen replacement.
